description: A Perl script for extracting target, device, architecture, and kernel information from OpenWrt build system Makefiles, with functions to parse target info and device info, and command-line interface for querying this data.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information from make output, populating targets, architectures, and kernels hashes.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device information from make output, populating devices hash.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target Makefiles to gather target and subtarget info, invoking parsing functions.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Retrieves device info for a specified target/subtarget.
